description: This file defines classes and types related to network requests, responses, and WebSocket handling within the Playwright core library, including request interception, header management, and request/response lifecycle management.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request, including headers, method, URL, and request body, with support for fallback overrides and request lifecycle management.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response, providing access to status, headers, body, and related request information.

classes.name: WebSocket
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket connection, handling message sending, receiving, and connection state.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: Handles request interception, allowing aborting, fulfilling, or continuing requests, with support for request fallback overrides.

classes.name: WebSocketRoute
classes.description: Manages WebSocket route interception, message handling, and connection control.

classes.name: WebSocketRouteHandler
classes.description: Defines a handler for WebSocket route interception patterns, including matching and handling logic.

classes.name: RouteHandler
classes.description: Manages request route handling, including invocation count, expiration, and error handling.

classes.name: RawHeaders
classes.description: Utility class for managing HTTP headers, supporting case-insensitive access and multiple header values.

methods.name: headers
methods.description: Returns headers as a Headers object.

methods.name: _actualHeaders
methods.description: Fetches the actual headers from the network response.

methods.name: allHeaders
methods.description: Returns all headers as a Headers object.

methods.name: headersArray
methods.description: Returns headers as an array of name-value pairs.

methods.name: headerValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific header.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Returns the response body as a Buffer.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Returns the response body as a UTF-8 string.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Parses and returns the response body as JSON.

methods.name: connectToServer
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the WebSocket server.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message over the WebSocket.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specific WebSocket event with optional predicate.

methods.name: prepareInterceptionPatterns
methods.description: Prepares URL patterns for request or WebSocket interception.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if a URL matches the route handler pattern.
